technology_type.evidence: The instrument was operated in targeted M2 acquisition mode with an MS1 spectrum acquired over the mass range 300–1300 m/z (120,000 resolution, 100% automatic gain control (AGC) and 50 ms maximum injection time) followed by targeted MS/MS via HCD fragmentation with 0.7 m/z isolation (60,000 resolution, 200% AGC, 300 ms maximum injection time and stepped normalised collision energy 25, 30 and 35 eV).
